spans.s: ऋतु m. 1. A period of the year, a season; there are six seasons in a Hindu year- शिशिरः पुष्यसमयो ग्रीष्मो वर्षा शरद्धिमः; 2. The menstrual evacuation; 3. the period favourable for conception, e.g. ऋतौ भार्यामुपेयात्; 4. fit season; 5. light; 6. the number ‘six.’
ऋतु-काल m. 1. the duration of a season; 2. the time favourable for conception, viz., sixteen nights from menstrual evacuation.
ऋतु-गामिन् m. having intercourse with a wife at a time favourable for conception.
ऋतु-पर्याय m. the revolution of the seasons.
ऋतु-मती f. a woman during her courses.
ऋतु-मुख n. the beginning of a season.
ऋतु-राज m. the spring, e.g. ऋतुराजं भ्रमरहितम् &c. R.G.
ऋतु-लिंग n. 1. a characteristic of the season; 2. a symptom of menstruation.
ऋतु-वृत्ति f. revolution of the seasons.
ऋतु-संधि m. the junction of two seasons.
ऋतु-स्नाता f. a woman who has bathed after menstruation and so prepared herself for sexual intercourse, R.i.76.
